arxiv-1605-03284.title: Machine Comprehension Based on Learning to Rank
arxiv-1605-03284.creator: Tian Tian, Yuezhang Li
arxiv-1605-03284.description: Abstract Machine comprehension plays an essential role in NLP and has been widely explored with dataset like MCTest. However, this dataset is too simple and too small for learning true reasoning abilities. [ \citenameHermann et al.2015 ] therefore release a large scale news article dataset and propose a deep LSTM reader system for machine comprehension.

arxiv-2111-01805.title: Giant proximity exchange and flat Chern band in 2D magnet-semiconductor heterostructures
arxiv-2111-01805.creator: Nisarga Paul, Yang Zhang, Liang Fu
arxiv-2111-01805.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nisarga Paul, Yang Zhang, Liang Fu. Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures formed by two-dimensional magnets and semiconductors have provided a fertile ground for fundamental science and spintronics. We present first-principles calculations finding a proximity exchange splitting of 14 meV (equivalent to an effective Zeeman field of 120 T) in the vdW magnet-semiconductor heterostructure MoS 2 /CrBr 3 , leading to a 2D spin-polarized half-metal with carrier densities ranging up to 10 13 10^{13} cm -2 .

arxiv-2504-08941.title: TRI-BN-25-6: Cyclotron Spiral Inflector
arxiv-2504-08941.creator: Rick Baartman, TRIUMF
arxiv-2504-08941.description: Abstract The most common device for injecting into a compact cyclotron is an electrostatic device known as the spiral inflector. There is a known analytic solution for the trajectory, and therefore the electrode shape, in the idealized case of a uniform magnetic field. This is re-derived in this note and the conditions for perfect centring are found.

arxiv-2505-14192.title: QSVM-QNN: Quantum Support Vector Machine Based Quantum Neural Network Learning Algorithm for Brain-Computer Interfacing Systems
arxiv-2505-14192.creator: Bikash K. Behera, Saif Al-Kuwari, Ahmed Farouk
arxiv-2505-14192.description: Abstract A brain-computer interface (BCI) system enables direct communication between the brain and external devices, offering significant potential for assistive technologies and advanced human-computer interaction. Despite progress, BCI systems face persistent challenges, including signal variability, classification inefficiency, and difficulty adapting to individual users in real time.

pmc-10572740.title: Prevalence of Reproductive Health Issues among US Female Law Enforcement Officers
pmc-10572740.creator: Ainslie Kehler, Sara Jahnke, Filip Kukić, Aspen E Streetman, Katie M Heinrich, Nicholas R Heebner, Emily Lynn Langford, Mark Abel
pmc-10572740.description: Reproductive health is a considerable concern among US female law enforcement officers (LEOs). Miscarriage and preterm birth rates are significantly higher in women firefighters than published US averages. Since law enforcement and firefighting share occupational conditions and practices, adverse birth outcomes were hypothesized to be greater in female law enforcement officers (LEOs) than the US averages.

pmc-11341572.title: Peptide-mimetic treatment of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in a mouse model of respiratory infection
pmc-11341572.creator: Madeleine G. Moule, Aaron B. Benjamin, Melanie L. Burger, Claudine Herlan, Maxim Lebedev, Jennifer S. Lin, Kent J. Koster, Neha Wavare, Leslie G. Adams, Stefan Bräse, Ricardo Munoz-Medina, Carolyn L. Cannon, Annelise E. Barron, Jeffrey D. Cirillo
pmc-11341572.description: The rise of drug resistance has become a global crisis, with >1 million deaths due to resistant bacterial infections each year. Pseudomonas aeruginosa, in particular, remains a serious problem with limited solutions due to complex resistance mechanisms that now lead to more than 32,000 multidrug-resistant (MDR) infections and over 2000 deaths in the U.S. annually.

pmc-11355713.title: Retrospective Longitudinal Observational Study on the Long-Term Effects of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors on the Development of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease in Type 2 Diabetic Japanese Patients
pmc-11355713.creator: Hisayuki Katsuyama, Seiichi Horinaka, Mariko Hakoshima, Hiroki Adachi, Hidekatsu Yanai, Gerond V Lake-Bakaar
pmc-11355713.description: Background/Objectives: The health burden of metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MASLD) has been increasing lately. Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the main cause of death in MASLD patients; therefore, the treatments for MASLD should improve both CV risk factors such as obesity, diabetes, and dyslipidemia, in addition to an improvement in liver function.

pmc-11363886.title: Pulmonary Vein in a Pinch
pmc-11363886.creator: Muhab Saadeh, Ayham Mahmoud, Mahmoud Ma’aita, Asal Eiadeh, Ayman Hammoudeh, Mousa Saadeh, Moath Said Alfawara
pmc-11363886.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The pulmonary veins normally drain into the left atrium, with the superior pulmonary veins typically situated anterior and inferior to the right pulmonary arteries. However, anomalies can happen. We encountered an exceedingly rare pulmonary vascular anomaly for a patient presenting with atypical chest pain, where the right superior pulmonary vein aberrantly ran posterior to the right pulmonary artery (RPA) and became compressed between the RPA and the right main bronchus.

pmc-11434177.title: Tryptase: The Silent Witness of Past and Ongoing Systemic Events
pmc-11434177.creator: Irena Oštrić Pavlović, Sara Radović, Danka Krtinić, Jelena Spirić, Nataša Kusić, Antonije Veličković, Vesna Tomić-Spirić
pmc-11434177.description: Introduction: Tryptase is an important biomarker widely used in the laboratory confirmation of severe hypersensitivity reactions, especially anaphylaxis. It also plays a crucial role in the diagnosis, risk stratification, management and prognostic evaluation of many other mast cell-related conditions. Aim: This paper aims to highlight the role of serum tryptase, both in allergic disorders and other mast cell-related conditions.

pmc-13115133.title: Occurrence, Dietary Exposure Scenarios and Risk Assessment of Aflatoxins from Dried Fruits and Chocolates in Armenia
pmc-13115133.creator: Davit Pipoyan, Meline Beglaryan, Yepraqsya Arshakyan, Bagrat Harutyunyan
pmc-13115133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aimed to estimate dietary exposure to aflatoxins (AFs) and characterize its associated risks through the consumption of dried fruits and chocolates among the adult population of Yerevan, the capital city of Armenia. Asflatoxin B1 (AFB1) and total AFs were determined using HPLC in 10 composite samples of widely consumed dried fruits and chocolates, prepared by pooling 100 individual sub-samples into 5 dried fruits and 5 chocolate composites.

pmc-13403111.title: Systems-based psychiatry: insights from psychedelic research on mechanisms of healing
pmc-13403111.creator: Scott Shannon, Andrew Weil
pmc-13403111.description: Current psychiatric models, while clinically valuable, remain limited in their ability to account for the complexity, variability, and context dependence of mental disorders. Converging evidence from neuroscience, complexity science, and psychedelic research suggests that psychiatric symptoms may be better understood as stable patterns of organization within dynamic, multilevel systems rather than as outputs of isolated biological dysfunction.
